# fuzzy-match-scorer

> Zero-dependency fuzzy string matching (Levenshtein, Damerau-Levenshtein, Jaro-Winkler, token-set ratio) with bestMatch/rankMatches helpers.

fuzzy-match-scorer resolves a slightly-wrong string against a list of known
candidates, returning a normalized 0-1 similarity score. It exists because
agents and CLIs constantly need to match typo'd tool/command names, fuzzy
user queries, or near-miss identifiers against a known vocabulary — this
package does that with strict TypeScript, zero runtime dependencies, and
four selectable algorithms (character-edit-distance based and token based).

## API

- `levenshtein(a: string, b: string): number` — raw edit distance.
- `damerauLevenshtein(a: string, b: string): number` — edit distance incl. adjacent transpositions.
- `normalizedLevenshtein(a: string, b: string): number` — 0-1 similarity.
- `normalizedDamerauLevenshtein(a: string, b: string): number` — 0-1 similarity.
- `jaro(a: string, b: string): number` — 0-1 Jaro similarity.
- `jaroWinkler(a: string, b: string, prefixScale?: number, maxPrefix?: number): number` — 0-1, prefix-boosted.
- `tokenSetRatio(a: string, b: string): number` — order-insensitive multi-word similarity.
- `rankMatches(query: string, candidates: readonly string[], options?: MatchOptions): RankedMatch[]`
- `bestMatch(query: string, candidates: readonly string[], options?: MatchOptions): RankedMatch | null`
- `type Algorithm = "levenshtein" | "damerau" | "jaro-winkler" | "token-set"`
- `interface MatchOptions { algorithm?: Algorithm; threshold?: number; caseSensitive?: boolean }`
- `interface RankedMatch { candidate: string; score: number; index: number }`

## Install

```bash
npm install fuzzy-match-scorer
```

Part of the Ferrow open-source toolkit: https://github.com/Ruzylo-cloud/ferrow-toolkit — sponsored by https://ferrow.ai
